title: Unknown session entries bypass required/ignorable classification
claim: SessionReader treats every unknown entry type as nonfatal and skipped, so it cannot fail closed on an unknown required semantic or reconstruct the durable Runtime Input Binding required by current INV-007 and P17-AUTH-001.

evidence.detail: The documented v1 policy says every unknown type tag is skipped, counted, and never fatal.
SessionEntry has no required/ignorable envelope field and no Runtime Input Binding entry.
The reader drains all unrecognized type tags into unknown_count and returns Ok.
The focused regression asserts a future unknown entry is skipped while the known entry survives.

title: Bedrock CRC-invalid frames are silently consumed
claim: The Bedrock event-stream parser drains a complete frame before validating it and converts CRC or structural validation failures into absence, allowing corrupted provider content to disappear without a typed terminal error.

evidence.detail: parse_frames returns Vec<EventFrame>, drains total_len bytes, and only pushes Some(frame); it has no error channel.
CRC and structural failures return None.
The production HTTP loop consumes the frame vector and has no malformed-frame result to propagate.
The unit test corrupts the message CRC and asserts both an empty result and an empty buffer.

criterion_source: AGENTS.md fail-closed validation at protocol/adapter boundaries; Phase 17 P17-FAL-001 and P17-FAL-002

title: Post-Allow evidence failure bypasses required reauthorization
claim: When authorization-evidence emission fails after an Allow and advances EvidenceHealth, preflight returns a batch-invalid denial without invoking ToolAuthorizer again against the new health snapshot, contrary to P17-A12's explicit stale-Allow reauthorization step.

evidence.detail: authorize_and_verify can retry only mismatches already present in the snapshot passed before authorization evidence is emitted.
Authorization evidence is emitted after authorize_and_verify returns.
An emission failure returns BatchInvalid immediately; no second authorization call occurs.
The authorization-record failure test proves zero launches but does not count or require reauthorization of the stale Allow.

title: Workspace gate ignores the resolved Cargo target directory
claim: The required cargo test --workspace --all-targets gate fails under the repository's external Cargo cache because five session_cli E2E tests hard-code the binary path under the workspace target directory.

evidence.detail: opi_binary constructs <workspace>/target/debug/opi(.exe) instead of using Cargo's binary path or the resolved target directory.
At the pinned head with the repository-resolved external cache, 5 session_cli E2E tests failed at line 845 because the hard-coded binary did not exist.
Repository verification requires the external Cargo cache workflow and lists the workspace all-targets gate.

criterion_source: Phase 17 design lines 785-796 phase-exit gate set; AGENTS.md Verification
reproduction: Set CARGO_TARGET_DIR from python scripts/opi-cargo-cache.py resolve under a cache lease, then run cargo test --workspace --all-targets

title: Rollback proof omits the required pre-Phase regression profile
claim: The frozen P17-RBK-002 evidence substitutes structural source review and explicitly states that no live revert/pre-Phase regression profile was executed, so the registered mechanical verification is incomplete.

evidence.detail: P17-RBK-002 mechanical verification requires revert review and a pre-Phase regression profile.
The recorded evidence says no live revert drill or pre-Phase regression profile was executed and relies on structural review instead.
